sentences.text: Agus membagikan bibit kopi kepada para petani di lereng gunung.
sentences.en: Agus handed out coffee seedlings to the farmers on the mountain slope.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 산비탈 농부들에게 커피 묘목을 나눠 줬어요.

sentences.text: Dalam surat itu, Wati bercerita tentang bibit mawar yang dia tanam di halaman.
sentences.en: In the letter, Wati wrote about the rose seedlings she planted in the yard.
sentences.ko: 와티는 편지에 마당에 심은 장미 묘목 이야기를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus pernah melihat reptil besar berbaring di batu dekat sungai.
sentences.en: Agus once saw a large reptile lying on a rock near the river.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 강가 바위 위에 누워 있는 큰 파충류를 본 적이 있어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa anak bungsunya sekarang tergila-gila pada reptil.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that her youngest child is now crazy about reptiles.
sentences.ko: 와티는 막내가 요즘 파충류에 푹 빠졌다고 적었어요.

sentences.text: Dengan teropong tua, Agus mengamati elang yang terbang di atas lembah.
sentences.en: With an old pair of binoculars, Agus watched an eagle flying over the valley.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 낡은 쌍안경으로 골짜기 위를 나는 독수리를 지켜봤어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengirim teropong kecil sebagai hadiah untuk sahabat yang suka mengamati burung.
sentences.en: Wati sent small binoculars as a gift to her friend who loves birdwatching.
sentences.ko: 와티는 새 관찰을 좋아하는 친구에게 작은 쌍안경을 선물로 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Udara di desa Agus selalu lembap setelah kabut turun.
sentences.en: The air in Agus's village is always damp after the fog comes down.
sentences.ko: 안개가 내려오고 나면 아구스네 마을 공기는 늘 축축해요.

sentences.text: Wati mengeluh bahwa kertas surat di rumah jadi lembap karena musim hujan.
sentences.en: Wati complained that the writing paper at home had gotten damp from the rainy season.
sentences.ko: 와티는 우기 때문에 집에 있는 편지지가 눅눅해졌다고 투덜댔어요.

sentences.text: Agus mengantar para pendaki ke tepi kawah saat subuh.
sentences.en: Agus guided the hikers to the edge of the crater at dawn.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 새벽에 등산객들을 분화구 가장자리까지 안내했어요.

sentences.text: Wati menyelipkan foto kawah gunung yang dia kunjungi bulan lalu.
sentences.en: Wati slipped in a photo of the volcanic crater she visited last month.
sentences.ko: 와티는 지난달에 다녀온 산 분화구 사진을 끼워 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Di balai desa ada lonceng perunggu yang dibunyikan Agus setiap ada rapat.
sentences.en: In the village hall there is a bronze bell that Agus rings whenever there's a meeting.
sentences.ko: 마을 회관에는 회의가 있을 때마다 아구스가 치는 청동 종이 있어요.

sentences.text: Wati bercerita bahwa putrinya meraih medali perunggu dalam lomba renang.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that her daughter won a bronze medal in a swimming competition.
sentences.ko: 와티는 딸이 수영 대회에서 동메달을 땄다고 전했어요.

sentences.text: Agus mengajari anak-anak desa cara mendaur ulang botol plastik.
sentences.en: Agus taught the village children how to recycle plastic bottles.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 마을 아이들에게 플라스틱 병을 재활용하는 법을 가르쳤어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis di atas kertas yang dia buat dengan mendaur ulang koran bekas.
sentences.en: Wati wrote on paper she made by recycling old newspapers.
sentences.ko: 와티는 헌 신문을 재활용해 직접 만든 종이에 편지를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Rumah Agus berdinding anyaman bambu.
sentences.en: Agus's house has walls of woven bamboo.
sentences.ko: 아구스의 집은 대나무를 엮어 만든 벽으로 되어 있어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengenang pondok bambu tempat mereka dulu belajar bersama.
sentences.en: Wati recalled the bamboo hut where they used to study together.
sentences.ko: 와티는 예전에 함께 공부하던 대나무 오두막을 떠올렸어요.

sentences.text: Kakek Agus masih ingat saat gunung itu meletus puluhan tahun lalu.
sentences.en: Agus's grandfather still remembers when the mountain erupted decades ago.
sentences.ko: 아구스의 할아버지는 수십 년 전 그 산이 폭발했던 때를 아직 기억해요.

sentences.text: Wati bertanya apakah sahabatnya aman setelah gunung di dekat kota itu meletus.
sentences.en: Wati asked whether her friend was safe after the mountain near that town erupted.
sentences.ko: 와티는 그 도시 근처 산이 폭발한 뒤 친구가 무사한지 물었어요.

sentences.text: Agus melihat kemiripan antara batu di sungai dan batu di puncak.
sentences.en: Agus noticed a resemblance between the stones in the river and the stones on the summit.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 강가의 돌과 산꼭대기 돌이 닮았다는 걸 알아챘어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa cucunya punya kemiripan wajah dengan sahabat mereka waktu kecil.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that her grandchild's face resembles their friend as a child.
sentences.ko: 와티는 손주 얼굴이 어릴 적 친구와 닮았다고 적었어요.

sentences.text: Menurut Agus, kehidupan di desa tidak statis karena selalu ada yang berubah setiap musim.
sentences.en: According to Agus, village life isn't static because something always changes each season.
sentences.ko: 아구스 말로는 계절마다 늘 뭔가 바뀌어서 마을 생활이 정체돼 있지 않대요.

sentences.text: Wati mengaku hidup terasa statis sejak dia pensiun.
sentences.en: Wati admitted that life has felt static since she retired.
sentences.ko: 와티는 은퇴한 뒤로 삶이 정체된 느낌이라고 털어놓았어요.

sentences.text: Agus membuat perbandingan hasil panen kentang tahun ini dan tahun lalu.
sentences.en: Agus compared this year's potato harvest with last year's.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 올해와 작년 감자 수확량을 비교해 봤어요.

sentences.text: Wati membuat perbandingan lucu antara masa sekolah mereka dan masa sekarang.
sentences.en: Wati made a funny comparison between their school days and the present.
sentences.ko: 와티는 학창 시절과 지금을 재미있게 비교했어요.

sentences.text: Masa transisi dari musim hujan ke kemarau membuat Agus sibuk di ladang.
sentences.en: The transition from the rainy season to the dry season keeps Agus busy in the fields.
sentences.ko: 우기에서 건기로 넘어가는 시기에는 아구스가 밭에서 바빠요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis tentang transisi yang sulit dari desa ke kota besar.
sentences.en: Wati wrote about the hard transition from a village to a big city.
sentences.ko: 와티는 시골에서 대도시로 옮겨 가며 겪은 힘든 변화에 대해 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus merapatkan jaket saat embusan angin dingin datang dari puncak.
sentences.en: Agus pulled his jacket tight when a gust of cold wind came down from the summit.
sentences.ko: 산꼭대기에서 찬바람이 불어오자 아구스는 재킷을 여몄어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa setiap embusan angin laut mengingatkan dia pada sahabat lama.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that every breath of sea wind reminds her of her old friend.
sentences.ko: 와티는 바닷바람이 불 때마다 옛 친구가 생각난다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus khawatir jumlah wisatawan mengalami kemunduran karena jalan rusak.
sentences.en: Agus worries that the number of tourists will decline because of the damaged road.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 길이 망가져서 관광객 수가 줄어들까 봐 걱정해요.

sentences.text: Wati bercerita tentang kemunduran kesehatan ayahnya dengan nada tenang.
sentences.en: Wati wrote calmly about her father's declining health.
sentences.ko: 와티는 아버지의 건강이 나빠진 이야기를 담담하게 적었어요.

sentences.text: Agus mencurahkan seluruh tenaga untuk memperbaiki jalan setapak desa.
sentences.en: Agus poured all his energy into repairing the village footpath.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 마을 오솔길을 고치는 데 온 힘을 쏟았어요.

sentences.text: Wati mencurahkan isi hati dalam surat panjang untuk sahabat lama.
sentences.en: Wati poured out her heart in a long letter to her old friend.
sentences.ko: 와티는 옛 친구에게 쓰는 긴 편지에 속마음을 다 털어놓았어요.

sentences.text: Agus mencoret nama warga yang sudah membayar iuran air.
sentences.en: Agus crossed out the names of residents who had paid the water fee.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 물값을 낸 주민의 이름을 줄을 그어 지웠어요.

sentences.text: Wati mencoret beberapa kalimat sebelum menyalin surat itu dengan rapi.
sentences.en: Wati crossed out a few sentences before copying the letter out neatly.
sentences.ko: 와티는 편지를 깨끗이 옮겨 쓰기 전에 몇 문장을 지웠어요.

sentences.text: Dari puncak gunung, Agus bisa melihat kepulauan kecil di kejauhan saat cuaca cerah.
sentences.en: From the mountaintop, Agus can see a small archipelago in the distance on clear days.
sentences.ko: 날씨가 맑으면 아구스는 산꼭대기에서 멀리 있는 작은 섬들을 볼 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Wati bermimpi berlibur bersama sahabatnya ke kepulauan di timur.
sentences.en: Wati dreams of a holiday with her friend to the islands in the east.
sentences.ko: 와티는 친구와 함께 동쪽 섬들로 여행 가는 꿈을 꿔요.

sentences.text: Agus memungut siput berlendir dari daun kubis.
sentences.en: Agus picked slimy snails off the cabbage leaves.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 양배추 잎에서 끈적한 달팽이를 떼어 냈어요.

sentences.text: Wati tertawa saat menulis tentang siput berlendir yang dulu mereka pelihara.
sentences.en: Wati laughed as she wrote about the slimy snail they once kept as a pet.
sentences.ko: 와티는 예전에 함께 키우던 끈적한 달팽이 이야기를 쓰며 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Kambing Agus yang hilang akhirnya terlacak berkat jejak kaki di lumpur.
sentences.en: Agus's missing goat was finally tracked down thanks to footprints in the mud.
sentences.ko: 아구스의 잃어버린 염소는 진흙에 남은 발자국 덕분에 마침내 찾아냈어요.

sentences.text: Surat Wati sempat hilang, tetapi akhirnya terlacak di kantor pos lain.
sentences.en: Wati's letter went missing for a while, but it was eventually traced to another post office.
sentences.ko: 와티의 편지는 한동안 사라졌지만 결국 다른 우체국에서 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Agus membawa sekotak korek api ke pondok di hutan.
sentences.en: Agus took a box of matches to the hut in the forest.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 숲속 오두막에 성냥 한 갑을 가져갔어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengirim sekotak kue kering bersama surat untuk sahabatnya.
sentences.en: Wati sent a box of cookies along with the letter to her friend.
sentences.ko: 와티는 친구에게 편지와 함께 쿠키 한 상자를 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Agus menggantung sangkar burung perkutut di teras rumah.
sentences.en: Agus hung the dove's cage on the porch.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 집 테라스에 비둘기 새장을 걸었어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa dia masih ingat burung kenari di sangkar kuning milik mereka dulu.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that she still remembers the canary in the yellow cage they used to have.
sentences.ko: 와티는 예전에 노란 새장에서 키우던 카나리아를 아직 기억한다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus pernah terpuruk ketika longsor merusak ladang keluarga.
sentences.en: Agus once hit rock bottom when a landslide destroyed the family's field.
sentences.ko: 산사태로 집안 밭이 망가졌을 때 아구스는 크게 좌절했었어요.

sentences.text: Wati menyemangati sahabatnya yang sedang terpuruk setelah kehilangan pekerjaan.
sentences.en: Wati encouraged her friend, who was at a low point after losing her job.
sentences.ko: 와티는 일자리를 잃고 힘들어하는 친구를 격려했어요.

sentences.text: Agus memangkas cabang tua untuk merangsang tumbuhnya tunas baru.
sentences.en: Agus pruned the old branches to stimulate the growth of new shoots.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 새순이 돋도록 오래된 가지를 쳐 냈어요.

sentences.text: Wati percaya menulis surat dengan tangan bisa merangsang ingatan lama.
sentences.en: Wati believes that writing letters by hand can stir up old memories.
sentences.ko: 와티는 손으로 편지를 쓰면 옛 기억이 되살아난다고 믿어요.

sentences.text: Agus memejamkan mata dan mendengarkan suara air terjun.
sentences.en: Agus closed his eyes and listened to the sound of the waterfall.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 눈을 감고 폭포 소리를 들었어요.

sentences.text: Sebelum menulis, Wati memejamkan mata dan membayangkan wajah sahabatnya.
sentences.en: Before writing, Wati closed her eyes and pictured her friend's face.
sentences.ko: 와티는 편지를 쓰기 전에 눈을 감고 친구 얼굴을 떠올렸어요.

sentences.text: Warga desa memperdebatkan rencana jalan baru di rumah Agus.
sentences.en: The villagers debated the plan for a new road at Agus's house.
sentences.ko: 마을 사람들은 아구스의 집에서 새 도로 계획을 두고 토론했어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengingat masa ketika mereka memperdebatkan judul lagu sampai larut malam.
sentences.en: Wati remembered the days when they would argue about song titles late into the night.
sentences.ko: 와티는 둘이 밤늦게까지 노래 제목을 두고 다투던 시절을 떠올렸어요.

sentences.text: Agus merasa para pemandu gunung sepantasnya dibayar lebih.
sentences.en: Agus feels that mountain guides deserve to be paid more.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 산악 가이드들이 마땅히 더 받아야 한다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa persahabatan mereka yang panjang sepantasnya dirayakan.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that their long friendship deserves to be celebrated.
sentences.ko: 와티는 오랜 우정을 마땅히 축하해야 한다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus bercerita bahwa desa di kaki gunung dulu punya tambang batu bara.
sentences.en: Agus said that the village at the foot of the mountain used to have a coal mine.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 산기슭 마을에 예전에 탄광이 있었다고 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Wati bercerita bahwa kota kecil tempat dia lahir dulu hidup dari tambang batu bara.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that the small town where she was born used to live off coal mining.
sentences.ko: 와티는 자기가 태어난 작은 도시가 예전에 탄광으로 먹고살았다고 적었어요.

sentences.text: Agus tahu longsor kecil tak terelakkan kalau hujan turun berhari-hari.
sentences.en: Agus knows small landslides are unavoidable when it rains for days.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 비가 며칠씩 내리면 작은 산사태를 피할 수 없다는 걸 알아요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa perpisahan mereka dulu memang tak terelakkan.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that their parting back then had been unavoidable.
sentences.ko: 와티는 그때 둘의 이별은 어쩔 수 없었다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus menggali sumur baru untuk menghadapi kekeringan.
sentences.en: Agus dug a new well to cope with the drought.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 가뭄에 대비해 새 우물을 팠어요.

sentences.text: Wati bertanya apakah kebun sahabatnya selamat dari kekeringan tahun ini.
sentences.en: Wati asked whether her friend's garden had survived this year's drought.
sentences.ko: 와티는 친구의 밭이 올해 가뭄을 잘 넘겼는지 물었어요.

sentences.text: Agus pernah menonton film tentang gletser yang mencair di kutub.
sentences.en: Agus once watched a film about glaciers melting at the poles.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 극지방 빙하가 녹는 영화를 본 적이 있어요.

sentences.text: Wati melampirkan kartu pos bergambar gletser dari perjalanan putranya.
sentences.en: Wati enclosed a postcard with a picture of a glacier from her son's trip.
sentences.ko: 와티는 아들이 여행에서 보낸 빙하 그림엽서를 동봉했어요.

sentences.text: Agus membuat pupuk kompos dari sisa sayuran.
sentences.en: Agus makes compost fertilizer from vegetable scraps.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 남은 채소로 퇴비를 만들어요.

sentences.text: Wati meminta resep pupuk alami yang dulu dipakai ibu sahabatnya.
sentences.en: Wati asked for the natural fertilizer recipe her friend's mother used to use.
sentences.ko: 와티는 친구 어머니가 쓰시던 천연 비료 만드는 법을 물었어요.

sentences.text: Agus menunjukkan ikan mas dengan sirip merah kepada anaknya.
sentences.en: Agus showed his child a carp with red fins.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 아이에게 지느러미가 빨간 잉어를 보여 줬어요.

sentences.text: Wati menggambar ikan kecil dengan sirip biru di pojok surat.
sentences.en: Wati drew a little fish with blue fins in the corner of the letter.
sentences.ko: 와티는 편지 귀퉁이에 파란 지느러미를 단 작은 물고기를 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Agus menaburkan kerikil di jalan setapak supaya tidak licin.
sentences.en: Agus spread gravel on the footpath so it wouldn't be slippery.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 미끄럽지 않게 오솔길에 자갈을 깔았어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa jalan di depan rumah orang tuanya masih berupa kerikil seperti dulu.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that the road in front of her parents' house is still gravel, just like before.
sentences.ko: 와티는 부모님 집 앞 길이 예전처럼 아직 자갈길이라고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus membacakan buku anak tentang rakun yang suka mencuri makanan.
sentences.en: Agus read aloud a children's book about a raccoon that loves to steal food.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 음식을 훔치기 좋아하는 너구리 이야기 동화책을 읽어 줬어요.

sentences.text: Wati bercerita tentang rakun di kebun binatang yang membuat cucunya tertawa.
sentences.en: Wati wrote about a raccoon at the zoo that made her grandchild laugh.
sentences.ko: 와티는 손주를 웃게 한 동물원 너구리 이야기를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Agus membuat kanal kecil untuk mengalirkan air dari mata air ke sawah.
sentences.en: Agus built a small canal to carry water from the spring to the rice field.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 샘물을 논으로 끌어오려고 작은 수로를 만들었어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengirim foto kanal tua di kota tempat dia sekarang tinggal.
sentences.en: Wati sent a photo of an old canal in the city where she now lives.
sentences.ko: 와티는 지금 사는 도시의 오래된 운하 사진을 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Daun tomat di kebun Agus mulai layu karena panas.
sentences.en: The tomato leaves in Agus's garden are starting to wilt from the heat.
sentences.ko: 더위 때문에 아구스네 밭의 토마토 잎이 시들기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Wati menyelipkan bunga yang sudah layu di dalam amplop.
sentences.en: Wati tucked a wilted flower into the envelope.
sentences.ko: 와티는 시든 꽃 한 송이를 봉투 안에 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Agus memakai kompas magnetik saat menuntun pendaki di tengah kabut.
sentences.en: Agus uses a magnetic compass when leading hikers through the fog.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 안개 속에서 등산객을 안내할 때 자석 나침반을 써요.

sentences.text: Wati bercerita bahwa pintu kulkas penuh hiasan magnetik dari berbagai kota.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that her fridge door is covered with magnetic souvenirs from many cities.
sentences.ko: 와티는 냉장고 문이 여러 도시에서 산 자석 장식으로 가득하다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Guru sekolah desa meminjam mikroskop Agus untuk melihat plankton dari kolam.
sentences.en: The village teacher borrowed Agus's microscope to look at plankton from the pond.
sentences.ko: 마을 학교 선생님이 연못 플랑크톤을 보려고 아구스의 현미경을 빌려 갔어요.

sentences.text: Wati menulis bahwa putranya kini meneliti plankton di laut.
sentences.en: Wati wrote that her son now studies plankton in the sea.
sentences.ko: 와티는 아들이 지금 바다 플랑크톤을 연구한다고 적었어요.

sentences.text: Agus memungut ulat dari daun kol satu per satu.
sentences.en: Agus picked the caterpillars off the cabbage leaves one by one.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 양배추 잎에서 애벌레를 하나씩 떼어 냈어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengenang saat mereka memelihara ulat sampai menjadi kupu-kupu.
sentences.en: Wati recalled when they raised a caterpillar until it became a butterfly.
sentences.ko: 와티는 둘이 애벌레를 나비가 될 때까지 키우던 때를 떠올렸어요.
